id: \rIris: Do you think I could ask Cynthia and Diantha for a picture? I'm so nervous.
en: \rIris: Do you think I could ask Cynthia and Diantha for a picture? I'm so nervous.
it: \rIris: Secondo te posso chiedere a Camilla e a Diantha una foto? Sono così agitata.

id: \bDo you think I can enter one day?
en: \bDo you think I can enter one day?
it: \bSecondo te un giorno potrò partecipare anch'io?

id: \bIndeedee
en: \bIndeedee
it: \bIndeedee

id: \rDawn: You're in the finals! No need to worry though. I know you'll win.
en: \rDawn: You're in the finals! No need to worry though. I know you'll win.
it: \rLucinda: Sei arrivato in finale! Comunque non c'è da preoccuparsi. So che vincerai.

id: \bThis room is only for the Masters Eight.
en: \bThis room is only for the Masters Eight.
it: \bQuesta sala è riservata agli Otto Master.

id: \bAlain will be my pick. Someone has to pick the underdog.
en: \bAlain will be my pick. Someone has to pick the underdog.
it: \bIo punto su Alain. Qualcuno dovrà pur tifare per lo sfavorito.

id: \rLeon's Charizard is unstoppable.
en: \rLeon's Charizard is unstoppable.
it: \rIl Charizard di Dandel è inarrestabile.

id: \rDiantha: How lovely to see you again. I hope you perform well against Steven.
en: \rDiantha: How lovely to see you again. I hope you perform well against Steven.
it: \rDiantha: Che piacere rivederti. Spero che te la cavi bene contro Rocco.

id: \rDiantha: I have to battle Leon next. Wish me luck.
en: \rDiantha: I have to battle Leon next. Wish me luck.
it: \rDiantha: Il mio prossimo incontro è contro Dandel. Augurami buona fortuna.

id: \rDiantha: Don't underestimate Leon. His raw strength is enough to overwhelm strategy.
en: \rDiantha: Don't underestimate Leon. His raw strength is enough to overwhelm strategy.
it: \rDiantha: Non sottovalutare Dandel. La sua forza bruta basta a travolgere qualsiasi strategia.

id: \rCynthia is my pick. Her elegance and calculations are going to put her above the pack.
en: \rCynthia is my pick. Her elegance and calculations are going to put her above the pack.
it: \rIo punto su Camilla. La sua eleganza e i suoi calcoli la porteranno sopra tutti gli altri.

id: \bRookidee
en: \bRookidee
it: \bRookidee

id: \rDratini
en: \rDratini
it: \rDratini

id: \bI've been following Leon for years. He never loses.
en: \bI've been following Leon for years. He never loses.
it: \bSeguo Dandel da anni. Non perde mai.

id: \bI made it to the top eight last year. It was tough.
en: \bI made it to the top eight last year. It was tough.
it: \bL'anno scorso sono arrivato tra i primi otto. È stata dura.

id: \bLance: It's nice to see each other under less dangerous circumstances.
en: \bLance: It's nice to see each other under less dangerous circumstances.
it: \bLance: È bello rivedersi in circostanze meno pericolose.

id: \bIris is my pick. Her Dragon past strikes a cord in me.
en: \bIris is my pick. Her Dragon past strikes a cord in me.
it: \bIo tifo per Iris. Il suo passato con i Draghi tocca le mie corde.

id: \bLeon: Thank you everyone for supporting me during this season, but there's an emergency outside. I need to...
en: \bLeon: Thank you everyone for supporting me during this season, but there's an emergency outside. I need to...
it: \bDandel: Grazie a tutti per avermi sostenuto in questa stagione, ma c'è un'emergenza qui fuori. Devo...

id: \bWait, you already dealt with it? What's your name?
en: \bWait, you already dealt with it? What's your name?
it: \bAspetta, te ne sei già occupato tu? Come ti chiami?

id: \b\PN, thank you. You saved the stadium from ruin. Let me give you this as thanks.
en: \b\PN, thank you. You saved the stadium from ruin.  Let me give you this as thanks.
it: \b\PN, grazie. Hai salvato lo stadio dalla rovina.  Lascia che ti dia questo come ringraziamento.

id: \bThat's a Dynamax Band. With it you'll be able to Dynamax your Pokémon in certain places in Galar.
en: \bThat's a Dynamax Band. With it you'll be able to Dynamax your Pokémon in certain places in Galar.
it: \bÈ un Polsino Dynamax. Con questo potrai far ricorso al Dynamax con i tuoi Pokémon in certi luoghi di Galar.

id: \bHow would you like to test it out in a battle against me? I'll meet you inside the stadium.
en: \bHow would you like to test it out in a battle against me? I'll meet you inside the stadium.
it: \bChe ne dici di provarlo in una lotta contro di me? Ci vediamo dentro lo stadio.

id: \bAnd to everyone else, I promise I'll keep doing my best to deliver the greatest battles for you all to watch!
en: \bAnd to everyone else, I promise I'll keep doing my best to deliver the greatest battles for you all to watch!
it: \bE a tutti gli altri prometto che continuerò a dare il massimo per offrirvi le lotte più spettacolari!

id: \bLeon: How would you like to test it out in a battle against me? I'll meet you inside the stadium.
en: \bLeon: How would you like to test it out in a battle against me? I'll meet you inside the stadium.
it: \bDandel: Che ne dici di provarlo in una lotta contro di me? Ci vediamo dentro lo stadio.

id: \rHello. Welcome to Wyndon Stadium.
en: \rHello. Welcome to Wyndon Stadium.
it: \rSalve. Benvenuto allo Stadio di Wyndon.

id: \rHello, \PN of the Masters 8. Would you like ask the current Monarch to hold a Masters 8 tournament now?
en: \rHello, \PN of the Masters 8. Would you like ask the current Monarch to hold a Masters 8 tournament now?
it: \rSalve, \PN degli Otto Master. Vuoi chiedere all'attuale Monarca di organizzare ora un torneo degli Otto Master?

id: \rHello, Monarch \PN. Would you like to hold a Masters 8 tournament now?
en: \rHello, Monarch \PN. Would you like to hold a Masters 8 tournament now?
it: \rSalve, Monarca \PN. Vuoi organizzare ora un torneo degli Otto Master?

id: \rOk, please give me a moment to contact them...
en: \rOk, please give me a moment to contact them...
it: \rBene, dammi un attimo per contattarli...

id: \rAlright, let's set it up.
en: \rAlright, let's set it up.
it: \rD'accordo, organizziamolo.

id: \rEnjoy and good luck!
en: \rEnjoy and good luck!
it: \rDivertiti e buona fortuna!

id: \rNo problem. Have a good day.
en: \rNo problem. Have a good day.
it: \rNessun problema. Buona giornata.

id: \bThere are no matches taking place right now.
en: \bThere are no matches taking place right now.
it: \bAl momento non ci sono incontri in corso.

id: \bYou're the Trainer Leon agreed to challenge. Are you ready?
en: \bYou're the Trainer Leon agreed to challenge. Are you ready?
it: \bSei tu l'Allenatore che Dandel ha accettato di sfidare. Sei pronto?

id: \bYou're \PN? You're late. We were about to call the match in Marnie's favor.
en: \bYou're \PN? You're late. We were about to call the match in Marnie's favor.
it: \bSei tu \PN? Sei in ritardo. Stavamo per dare la vittoria a tavolino a Mary.

id: \bWhatever. You're here now. Get in there.
en: \bWhatever. You're here now. Get in there.
it: \bVa be'. Ormai sei qui. Entra.

id: \bParticipant \PN. Please follow me.
en: \bParticipant \PN. Please follow me.
it: \bPartecipante \PN. Prego, mi segua.

id: \bNow, Wyndon Stadium is crammed full with spectators. You can already hear cheers in anticipation of the heated battles.
en: \bNow, Wyndon Stadium is crammed full with spectators. You can already hear cheers in anticipation of the heated battles.
it: \bLo Stadio di Wyndon è stracolmo di spettatori. Si sentono già le grida d'attesa per le lotte infuocate.

id: \bThis is the Pokémon World Coronation Series Masters Tournament.
en: \bThis is the Pokémon World Coronation Series Masters Tournament.
it: \bQuesto è il Torneo dei Master della World Coronation Series.

id: \bThe biggest tournament in history, where the highest ranked eight, the Masters Eight, determine the greatest Pokémon battler.
en: \bThe biggest tournament in history, where the highest ranked eight, the Masters Eight, determine the greatest Pokémon battler.
it: \bIl torneo più grande della storia, in cui gli otto migliori in classifica, gli Otto Master, decreteranno il più grande lottatore Pokémon.

id: \bAnd so, which of them will be crowned the Championships Monarch?
en: \bAnd so, which of them will be crowned the Championships Monarch?
it: \bE allora, chi di loro sarà incoronato Monarca dei Campionati?

id: \bNow, let's introduce the Masters Eight.
en: \bNow, let's introduce the Masters Eight.
it: \bE ora presentiamo gli Otto Master.

id: \bParticipant \PN. Please follow me for your battle against Steven.
en: \bParticipant \PN. Please follow me for your battle against Steven.
it: \bPartecipante \PN. Prego, mi segua per la sua lotta contro Rocco.

id: \bParticipant \PN. Please follow me for your battle against Cynthia.
en: \bParticipant \PN. Please follow me for your battle against Cynthia.
it: \bPartecipante \PN. Prego, mi segua per la sua lotta contro Camilla.

id: \bWe are busy setting up for the finals. Please come back later.
en: \bWe are busy setting up for the finals. Please come back later.
it: \bStiamo preparando la finale. Torni più tardi, per favore.

id: \bIn the meantime, could you help us deal with some commotion in the city?
en: \bIn the meantime, could you help us deal with some commotion in the city?
it: \bNel frattempo, potresti aiutarci a gestire un po' di trambusto in città?

id: \bParticipant \PN. Please follow me for your battle against Leon.
en: \bParticipant \PN. Please follow me for your battle against Leon.
it: \bPartecipante \PN. Prego, mi segua per la sua lotta contro Dandel.

id: \bSteven: So it will be a battle between us. I wish you the best of luck.
en: \bSteven: So it will be a battle between us. I wish you the best of luck.
it: \bRocco: Quindi la lotta sarà tra noi due. Ti auguro buona fortuna.

id: \bLance just became Champion. He's on a roll and he'll win here too.
en: \bLance just became Champion. He's on a roll and he'll win here too.
it: \bLance è appena diventato Campione. È in gran forma e vincerà anche qui.

id: \bI want to battle Leon one day.
en: \bI want to battle Leon one day.
it: \bUn giorno voglio lottare contro Dandel.

id: \rDynamax is something that can be done at this stadium. It's not something you can do everywhere.
en: \rDynamax is something that can be done at this stadium. It's not something you can do everywhere.
it: \rIn questo stadio è possibile usare il Dynamax. Non è una cosa che si può fare ovunque.

id: \bLeon is the clear winner. Plus, he's very cool.
en: \bLeon is the clear winner. Plus, he's very cool.
it: \bDandel è il vincitore indiscusso. E poi è fighissimo.

id: \bGoh: Leon seems really strong.
en: \bGoh: Leon seems really strong.
it: \bGoh: Dandel sembra davvero forte.

id: \bGoh: That was a great battle, \PN. Should we head back to the lab?
en: \bGoh: That was a great battle, \PN. Should we head back to the lab?
it: \bGoh: È stata una gran lotta, \PN. Torniamo al laboratorio?

id: \rCynthia: I believe you'll do quite well here. I'm also happy to see Iris qualified.
en: \rCynthia: I believe you'll do quite well here. I'm also happy to see Iris qualified.
it: \rCamilla: Credo che te la caverai piuttosto bene qui. Sono anche felice che Iris si sia qualificata.

id: \rCynthia: Are you prepared for our battle? I certainly am.
en: \rCynthia: Are you prepared for our battle? I certainly am.
it: \rCamilla: Sei pronto per la nostra lotta? Io di sicuro sì.

id: \rCynthia: I'll be cheering for you.
en: \rCynthia: I'll be cheering for you.
it: \rCamilla: Farò il tifo per te.

id: \bDiantha has to win. She deserves it for her strategy.
en: \bDiantha has to win. She deserves it for her strategy.
it: \bDiantha deve vincere. Se lo merita per la sua strategia.

id: \rThe battle against Lance was intense. I couldn't take my eyes off of it.
en: \rThe battle against Lance was intense. I couldn't take my eyes off of it.
it: \rLa lotta contro Lance è stata intensa. Non riuscivo a staccarle gli occhi di dosso.

id: \bNin
en: \bNin
it: \bNin

id: \rSteelix
en: \rSteelix
it: \rSteelix

id: \bAlain: I'm not surprised to see you made it as well. Let's meet up in the finals like last time.
en: \bAlain: I'm not surprised to see you made it as well.  Let's meet up in the finals like last time.
it: \bAlain: Non mi sorprende che ce l'abbia fatta anche tu.  Ritroviamoci in finale come l'ultima volta.

id: \rSteven is the obvious choice. His skill in battle is better than everyone.
en: \rSteven is the obvious choice. His skill in battle is better than everyone.
it: \rRocco è la scelta più ovvia. In lotta è più abile di tutti.

id: \rHello, and welcome to the Pokémon Center.
en: \rHello, and welcome to the Pokémon Center.
it: \rCiao, benvenuto al Centro Pokémon.

id: \rWe restore your tired Pokémon to full health.
en: \rWe restore your tired Pokémon to full health.
it: \rQui rimettiamo in forze i tuoi Pokémon stanchi.

id: \rWould you like to rest your Pokémon?
en: \rWould you like to rest your Pokémon?
it: \rVuoi far riposare i tuoi Pokémon?

id: \rOK, I'll take your Pokémon for a few seconds.
en: \rOK, I'll take your Pokémon for a few seconds.
it: \rBene, prendo i tuoi Pokémon per qualche secondo.

id: \rYour Pokémon may be infected by PokeRus.
en: \rYour Pokémon may be infected by PokeRus.
it: \rI tuoi Pokémon potrebbero aver contratto il Pokérus.

id: \rLittle is known about the PokeRus except that they are microscopic life-forms that attach to Pokémon.
en: \rLittle is known about the PokeRus except that they are microscopic life-forms that attach to Pokémon.
it: \rSi sa poco del Pokérus, se non che si tratta di forme di vita microscopiche che si attaccano ai Pokémon.

id: \rWhile infected, Pokémon are said to grow exceptionally well.
en: \rWhile infected, Pokémon are said to grow exceptionally well.
it: \rSi dice che i Pokémon infetti crescano eccezionalmente bene.

id: \rThank you for waiting.
en: \rThank you for waiting.
it: \rGrazie per l'attesa.

id: \rWe've restored your Pokémon to full health.
en: \rWe've restored your Pokémon to full health.
it: \rI tuoi Pokémon sono di nuovo in piena forma.

id: \rWe hope to see you again!
en: \rWe hope to see you again!
it: \rTorna a trovarci!

id: \rFirst, you should restore your Pokémon to full health.
en: \rFirst, you should restore your Pokémon to full health.
it: \rPer prima cosa, dovresti rimettere in forze i tuoi Pokémon.

id: \rYour Pokémon have been healed to perfect health.
en: \rYour Pokémon have been healed to perfect health.
it: \rI tuoi Pokémon sono stati curati e sono in perfetta salute.

id: \rWe hope you excel!
en: \rWe hope you excel!
it: \rSpero che tu abbia successo!

id: \rI come here for every battle.
en: \rI come here for every battle.
it: \rVengo qui per ogni lotta.

id: \bLeon: The Masters Eight. Let's make this one even more exciting than the last!
en: \bLeon: The Masters Eight. Let's make this one even more exciting than the last!
it: \bDandel: Gli Otto Master. Rendiamo questa edizione ancora più emozionante della scorsa!

id: \bLeon: The next battle will be even better than the last.
en: \bLeon: The next battle will be even better than the last.
it: \bDandel: La prossima lotta sarà ancora meglio dell'ultima.

id: \bLeon: I'm pumped for our battle.
en: \bLeon: I'm pumped for our battle.
it: \bDandel: Non vedo l'ora di lottare con te.

id: \r\PN will win. I can feel it in my soul.
en: \r\PN will win. I can feel it in my soul.
it: \r\PN vincerà. Me lo sento nell'anima.

id: \bRaihan: Man, Leon sure is tough. No matter what I try I just can't best him.
en: \bRaihan: Man, Leon sure is tough. No matter what I try I just can't best him.
it: \bRaihan: Accidenti, Dandel è proprio tosto. Qualunque cosa provi, non riesco proprio a batterlo.

id: \bOh, you're in the World Coronation Series too? You still have a long way to go before reaching the Master Class.
en: \bOh, you're in the World Coronation Series too? You still have a long way to go before reaching the Master Class.
it: \bOh, partecipi anche tu alla World Coronation Series? Hai ancora tanta strada da fare prima di arrivare alla Classe Master.

id: \bWho knows, maybe you'll even battle me. But don't think I'll let you get in the way of me defeating Leon.
en: \bWho knows, maybe you'll even battle me. But don't think I'll let you get in the way of me defeating Leon.
it: \bChissà, magari lotterai persino contro di me. Ma non pensare che ti lascerò metterti tra me e la vittoria su Dandel.

id: \bRaihan: Who knows, maybe you'll even battle me. But don't think I'll let you get in the way of me defeating Leon.
en: \bRaihan: Who knows, maybe you'll even battle me.  But don't think I'll let you get in the way of me defeating Leon.
it: \bRaihan: Chissà, magari lotterai persino contro di me.  Ma non pensare che ti lascerò metterti tra me e la vittoria su Dandel.

id: \bLeon is amazing!
en: \bLeon is amazing!
it: \bDandel è fantastico!
